card.name: Last piece of capitalized abbreviations
card.fires_on: The final piece of an all-caps abbreviation that is split into parts, such as the Cs in CHCs, the IDs in NSAIDs, or the AD in NLAD. It is usually inside parentheses or right after the abbreviation is introduced.

modes.description: The closing Cs or IDs of acronyms like CHCs and NSAIDs.
